elements.element: Transition assistance provided on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) ... provide reasonable transition assistance
for a period of up to six (6) months following the Termination Date

elements.element: Return of Customer Data within 30 days
elements.evidence: within thirty (30) days of the Termination Date, return to the Company all Content, user information, customer data

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
elements.evidence: in a commonly used, machine-readable format" — machine-readable is express, but the format is stated as "commonly used" rather than "standard
(c) thereafter delete all such Content, user information, customer data ... from its systems
and certify such deletion in writing to the Company
up to six (6) months following the Termination Date
within thirty (30) days of the Termination Date, return to the Company all Content, user information, customer data

reasons: All preferred mechanics are present (6 months at then-current rates, 30-day return running from the Termination Date, then deletion plus written certification), and the 30-day return duty is unconditional — the "at the Company's request" condition attaches only to assistance in (a), not to data return.

The single shortfall is wording of the export format: the insertion says "commonly used, machine-readable format" rather than expressly a standard machine-readable format; substitute "standard machine-readable format" to close the preferred position exactly.
Fallback is comfortably exceeded (six months of assistance versus 90 days; return within 30 days), so the clause is acceptable as drafted; the format wording is a note, not a material deviation.

Insertion of a new section 4.3 for an entirely absent exit clause is concise and leaves the term, renewal, notice and Termination Payment mechanics untouched; no undefined term or dangling cross-reference introduced.
